_meta.measurement_method: systematic stratified sample (every ~6th row within each response-length tercile, ordered by id), classified via semantic LLM judgment across 4 independent raters (chunked), aggregated programmatically
_meta.confidence_tiers: high: n>=50 humorous instances in sample; medium: 20-49; low: <20 (exploratory, directional only)
_meta.field_status: all frequencies/splits below are INFERRED from the sample, tagged sample_n per mechanism

sarcasm.setup_structure: another character makes a statement or takes an action
sarcasm.transition_structure: speaker replies using words that literally mean the opposite of, or overstate, the sincere response
sarcasm.payoff_structure: tone/context signals the literal meaning is not intended, producing a mocking or needling effect

conversational_position.note: whole_response = entire line is the joke; tag_end = sincere lead-in then a zinger; embedded = joke sits mid-response among other content

sarcasm.typical_context_note: last_speaker distribution largely tracks each character's overall share of context lines in the sample; treat as weak/directional signal, not a strong per-mechanism trigger, except where a mechanism's distribution diverges notably from the overall sampled baseline (Monica Geller 95, Joey Tribbiani 88, Ross Geller 80, Rachel Green 63, other_character 47, Phoebe Buffay 47 out of 425 sampled context lines).
